skills_considered.reason: The reading pipeline itself: M0 packet, acquisition, section-by-section read, manifest, receipt.

Its cascade logic was needed in substance: PMC holds NO PDF for this article (pmc_pow_fetch 404, ?pdf=render 404), so the winning route was the PMC reader HTML reached under no User-Agent plus the blob CDN for figures and figshare for the supplement the metadata denied.

No trigger fired: no prior manifest exists for this PMID so no persisted locator is contradicted, and this manifest narrows, reverses, corroborates or removes no consolidated baseline claim - claim movement is proposed in the candidate with an R4 precondition, not taken here.

The discovery-shaped leads here - zyxin as an intervention-supported IL-8 mediator, SOD2 loss, the SMAD3 hypothesis - are already captured as locators and are routed to the M4b note; a separate discovery pass would restate them.

No therapeutic lever matures toward the reference genotype from this paper: the tissue is lung, the stimulus is mechanical ventilation, and zyxin is a mechanotransducer with no CNS evidence offered here.
No candidate molecule and no SMILES in this reading; the only agents are siRNAs and tamoxifen used as research tools.
Refused on principle: it needs an API key and external traffic, and external spend of any kind is reserved under LEGEND_CORE 21d and is never mine.

group_assessment.weighting: The same senior laboratory as the first paper of this lot - Singla, 19 publications under 'Singla Sunit'[Full Author Name] and 4 on WWOX (measured 2026-09-13); the bare 'Singla S'[au] count of 794 is not one person and is not used. Aldaz is again primary for the GENE (66 publications, 28 on WWOX) and again contributes a REAGENT, the floxed mouse, at position 9 of 11. The author list is NOT the same as the first paper's: Abdelwahid, Ascoli and Pham are added, while Ware, Crotty Alexander, Moshensky, Shakir and Khan - the human-cohort and e-cigarette contributors - are gone, which fits a study that dropped the exposure arms. NEITHER group is primary for the disease this repository models. WEIGHTING CONSEQUENCE: this is an experimental laboratory reporting a POSITIVE result that is congruent with its own prior interest, so the interpretation is weighted accordingly - the opposite situation from the first paper, whose central finding was a null against the group's own prior claim. The intervention experiment (dual silencing) and the selectivity of its outcome are what carry the zyxin conclusion, not the group's authority.

field_density.reading: The decisive asymmetry: zyxin has 26 records with ventilation/stretch and only 1 with WWOX - this paper. WWOX and VILI is 1 record, WWOX and mechanotransduction is 1 record, WWOX and SOD2 is 1 record: each of this paper's three mechanistic novelties is a literature of exactly one paper, itself. Against 136 records for WWOX and brain. So the zyxin arm is not a convergent finding in the literature; it is a single-source finding whose PRIOR half (zyxin responds to stretch, 26 records) is well populated and whose WWOX half is this paper alone.

preprint_comparison.finding: Checked once. The author list is IDENTICAL between preprint and published version (11 authors, same order), unlike the first paper of the lot where one author was added. The preprint abstract carries the same architecture and the same claims: TMT-MS, zyxin upregulation, cyclic stretch 18% 0.5 Hz 4 h, dual silencing of WWOX and zyxin, VILI at 40 mL/kg 65 breath/min 4 h, and the selective result that dual silencing abrogates the IL-8 but not the IL-6 increase. The preprint abstract adds a framing sentence absent from the published abstract - 'Prior work has revealed a barrier protective function of WWOX during infectious models of ARDS' - which is a characterisation of the companion paper, not a new result. LIMIT DECLARED: abstract- and metadata-level comparison of the preprint RECORD only; the preprint full text was not retrieved and I cannot exclude a difference in sections I did not compare.

entries.proposition: Read as an image: A is the WWOX knockdown blot, B the immunostaining, C the volcano plot with SOD2 labelled far left and ZYX far right, D the zyxin blot and E zyxin mRNA as a 6-point dot plot with an asterisk. The volcano's thresholds are drawn as an adjusted-P line and TWO fold-change lines at -0.5 and +0.5, so significance here is a conjunction of P and effect size - which is why SOD1, significant at the same adjusted P but only -0.23, is not among the named hits.
entries.snippet: SOD2 ( superoxide dismutase 2 ) and ZYX ( zyxin ) were among the most significant differentially expressed proteins and were labeled for reference.

entries.proposition: Read as an image: all four BAL cytokines - IL-6, KC, IL-1beta and MCP-1 - carry significance brackets on the VILI KO versus VILI flox comparison. MCP-1's spontaneous-breathing comparison is marked ns. THIS IS THE PANEL THAT MAKES THE PAIR INTERESTING: the same laboratory's earlier paper found no significant BAL cytokine difference under LPS or MRSA at n = 3, and here, under mechanical injury at n = 10, all four are significant.
entries.snippet: These showed that VILI induced significantly higher IL6, KC, IL-1β, and MCP-1 generation in EC Wwox KO mice

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE ENDOTHELIAL-RESTRICTION CONTROL, AND IT DOES ITS JOB - with limits. Read as an image: WWOX and beta-actin blots across four lanes, WWOX flox and EC WWOX KO under spontaneous breathing and under ventilation, and the WWOX band is RETAINED and visually comparable in both EC WWOX KO lanes. That is the intended result: Wwox is not knocked down in BAL immune cells, so the tamoxifen-induced deletion is endothelium-restricted. THE LIMITS: the figure carries no caption text at all beyond 'Figure S1' - no n, no densitometry, no antibody, no statistics - and it is a single blot. It also prints the tidal volume as '40ml/g' where the Methods print 40 mL/kg.

entries.proposition: Read off the rendered supplemental table page: ZYX carries UniProt Q15942, a BH-adjusted P of 0.0001 and a log2 fold change of +0.55, i.e. about 1.46-fold, from 16.19 to 16.75 normalised intensity. entries.proposition: Read off the rendered supplemental table page: SOD2 carries UniProt P04179, a BH-adjusted P of 0.0001 and a log2 fold change of -0.94 (17.45 to 16.51) - a larger effect than zyxin's. SOD1 sits on the adjacent row at the same adjusted P but -0.23, inside the fold-change threshold, which is why the paper's two named proteins are a selection on prior biology and on effect size rather than the only corrected hits.

The supplement, by contrast, is a vector PDF and was rendered at 300 dpi.
